description: CROSS-REPO — owned and built in AGORA (downstream validator obligations), not koine. This also closes the last KGP 0.5.0 re-ratification blocker (ROADMAP.md Phase 1 / CLAUDE.md 'still-missing downstream round-trip fixture'). PARKED in koine: placeholder; move to agora/tasks/chief/ to activate.

userStories.description: In agora / the shared-validator repo, build the round-trip fixture proving a KGP §4 projection is lossless back to the canonical pack. koine ROADMAP marker; work is downstream per ADR-0001.
acceptanceCriteria: Implemented downstream (not koine): a fixture that takes a KGP canonical pack, projects it to RDF-star / PROV / JSON-LD (KGP §4, ADR-0006), and round-trips back byte-lossless to the canonical pack — the §3.3 claim-id convergence and the §7 confidence/license/local-only filters survive every encoding.

The fixture closes the last KGP 0.5.0 re-ratification blocker (the still-missing downstream round-trip fixture, CLAUDE.md / ROADMAP.md Phase 1); its clean result is fed back to koine as gate evidence, not by editing koine.
Runs under agora's own gates; no koine file is edited by this tasklist.
userStories.notes: Cross-repo (agora). Parked in koine as a ROADMAP F5 marker; also unblocks Phase 1 KGP re-ratification.
